decision: Restore Check updates in both GNOME and KDE menus through the single installed lay-update --menu entrypoint; group daily controls before settings, updates and diagnostics.
reason: The user explicitly requested the missing update action, a menu redesign and KDE support. The previous inventory omitted this action. Both frontends must use update.sh rather than a hardcoded checkout or a second updater. KDE updater terminals must survive the tray's own installation restart.
verification: Isolated executable updater tests cover GNOME/KDE terminal argv, read-only check, confirmation, source-only operation, divergence, lock contention and dirty-work preservation. Tray source contracts cover the shared entrypoint and daily group order. Remote full source gate, independent implementation review, release build and installed identity evidence are recorded in docs/lay-menu-settings-architecture.md as they finish.
not_tested: Historical Firefox/Chrome native input receipts do not certify this build. Input delivery routes and model authority are outside this menu change. A real Plasma desktop acceptance is distinct from offscreen Qt and source evidence.
